checks.command: Verify actual terminal receipts, immutable packets, saved manifests and profiles
checks.result: 112 completed jobs match their admitted manifests, configs, actual profile identities and original build lineage. All recorded build calls, new embeddings, API cost, uncertain attempts and prediction rows are zero. The 56 original Luna build lineages each have one Sol and one Astra packing job.

checks.command: Reconstruct all actual saved profiles under frozen f6 with a backend stub that rejects calls
checks.result: 112 full profiles reconstruct exactly. All 560 selected passages match exact source offsets and individual permissions. The 56 semantic builds reuse 28 pinned sparse bundles and the two original producer references. Runtime remained clean.

checks.command: Compare f6-rendered personalization against original sparse Luna controls at the same ordered item and cap
checks.result: All 112 new Sol/Astra rendered contexts equal the corresponding 56 original Luna profiles byte for byte. The matrix has 28 profiles for each of lexical/Sol, lexical/Astra, semantic/Sol and semantic/Astra; option reversals remain separate.
765 distinct artifact pins rehashed; all three reports identify the same 112 actual jobs. Root independently rerendered all 112 comparisons and verified the 8192-byte cap.

limitations: These are owning-method artifact checks with separate helper reviews, not an independent scientific audit or outcome score.
Actual future prediction packets and executed model requests are not covered. Their source, profile, model and settings bindings require the next check after Role09 emits concrete drafts.
The cap is 8192 canonical UTF-8 bytes of personalization, not 8192 provider tokens. Exact personalization parity does not assert equality of the complete model-specific wire payload.
The ready index remains its original prepared snapshot. Completion is established by the later summary and actual result/receipt artifacts, without rewriting preparation history.
Original sparse embedding production remains counted once in historical accounting; these zero-call packing builds do not create or recharge embeddings. No live ledger was read.

No private labels, prediction bodies, target traces, new source conditions or new judgments were used. These comparisons retain 14 underlying semantic judgments, two researchers and the original reversed-option rows.

The option-order sensitivity documented in handoff024 remains: some semantic retrieval contexts differ across reversed options. Matching the same ordered item across models does not remove that separate limitation.
